recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11185; future informationSource changes should be handled under later Pharmacy issues rather than this DSTU2 rename-and-target decision.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue originally asked that MedicationStatement.informationSource reference Any, but the accepted resolution narrowed that request to rename MedicationStatement.supportingInformation to MedicationStatement.derivedFrom, add Organization to MedicationStatement.informationSource, and update the definitions.
initial_application: Git commit 71c71d0b166b939f1daf16ce513c66bce931fc3d applied the issue in the then-authoritative MedicationStatement spreadsheet source by adding Organization to informationSource, renaming supportingInformation to derivedFrom, and updating the definitions. The combined branch did not previously contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-11185.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source keeps informationSource as the source/informant element with Organization and later approved targets, while derivedFrom is the Resource/Any-style link to material used to derive the MedicationStatement. The legacy supportingInformation path is still mapped to derivedFrom in fhir.ini. Later Pharmacy work including FHIR-41760 added a separate author element and reinforced that informationSource is distinct from author and from derivation artifacts.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition and version mapping already implement the accepted FHIR-11185 resolution, and changing informationSource to Reference(Any) would contradict the persuasive-with-modification decision and later source model.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Pharmacy issue added MedicationStatement.author and clarified informationSource as the source of the information, supporting the current source separation.
